integrity: The infinite theorem is proved symbolically; finite exact computation is used only as an independent regression check.
scientific_limitations: The density uses the box model 1<=a<=b<=N among well-formed weights.
The minimality notion is the weight-height notion for weighted-projective-plane mutation trees.
Classical squarefree-harmonic and summatory-totient error bounds are used without refinement.
title: Density one for mutation-minimal weighted projective planes of type \(\mathbb P(1,a,b)\)
